coverage.other_conditions: Covered property types include apartments, condominiums, townhomes, duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on the same parcel, hotel/motel/rooming/boarding house rooms occupied by the same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days, residential units attached to a commercial building, ADUs, JADUs, and mobile homes and RVs in mobile home parks; replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are also covered.
coverage.summary: Rental units subject to the Los Angeles RSO (first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units).
unverifiable_exemptions: Luxury exemption from the RSO, available on application based on the monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978

result.notes: I kept the construction cutoff (first built on or before 1978-10-01, plus replacement units) because D041 supports it. I removed the other_conditions claim that the rule is complementary to Civ. Code § 1950.5, and I set supersedes_state_rule to null, because no document addresses the state deposit statute. I replaced other_conditions with the covered property types listed in D041. I added the RSO luxury exemption as unverifiable, since it depends on rent levels from 1978. The year_built basis is the closest available enum value to D041's 'first built'.
